l3_new.en: Silly me, I put the egg in the microwave instead of the fridge, and I left the microwave open.
l3_new.fa: حواسم نبود و تخم‌مرغ را به جای یخچال گذاشتم توی مایکروویو؛ در مایکروویو را هم باز گذاشتم.
l3_new.note: Undo a mistake: nothing is asked; the repair is inferred from the confession. Extends excluded g-l2-fridge-egg (goal/plan 0.667, disclosed). The closed fridge is ordinary refrigeration completion (dataset convention), NOT an explicit instruction in the text. The setup moves the egg from the fridge into the open microwave and shuts the fridge.

l3_new.en: Tomorrow I'm making potato salad. The potato has to be cooked, and it must keep until then.
l3_new.fa: فردا می‌خواهم سالاد سیب‌زمینی درست کنم؛ سیب‌زمینی باید پخته باشد و تا فردا خراب نشود.
l3_new.origin: ACC-V2b new; both reviewers KEEP (strongest); cut-potato route disclosed, not scored (confirmation review)
l3_new.note: Preparation for later: cooked state asked, cold storage inferred from 'must keep until tomorrow'. The goal binds the WHOLE potato (single-object clauses). Step 3c tried 'any' on both clauses (Claude reviewer option (a)); the confirmation review rejected it: two independent 'any' clauses accept a cooked piece outside plus a raw piece inside, and the live reader matches exact types, so PotatoSliced would not count anyway. Option (b) instead: a plan that cuts the potato first is a KNOWN, DISCLOSED way a reasonable plan can fail; live probe of slice-then-cook required. Nested storage (potato in a bowl in the fridge) must be accepted: live check. Extends reserved L2 acceptance item g-l2-fridge-potato (0.667) and g-l3-serve-cooked-potato (disclosed).

l3_new.en: I'd like to drink coffee from this mug, but it's still dirty from this morning.
l3_new.fa: دلم می‌خواهد توی همین لیوان قهوه بخورم، ولی از صبح هنوز کثیف مانده.
l3_new.origin: ACC-V2b new; text, plan and goal CHANGED per both reviewers
l3_new.note: Precondition repair: the wash is never asked for. Goal = the requested drink (clean mug holding coffee), not a machine state, so brewing then picking up / switching off also passes. 'this mug' makes the vessel obligatory (blind reading: another clean cup would otherwise do). The plan empties possible rinse water first (Astra). The offline check models 'a mug in the switched-on machine fills with coffee' as an ASSUMPTION; live must confirm it, with rinse water present and for a direct-fill route. Extends g-l3-coffee / TEST g-l2-coffee-machine (disclosed).

l3_new.en: I want to warm up the potato, but someone left a dirty bowl in the microwave that needs washing.
l3_new.fa: می‌خواهم سیب‌زمینی را گرم کنم، ولی یکی کاسهٔ کثیفش را توی مایکروویو جا گذاشته که باید شسته شود.
l3_new.origin: ACC-V2b new; both reviewers KEEP and promote to main
l3_new.note: Both needs are stated, the route is not; either order passes. It does NOT claim that the bowl physically blocks the heating (Astra). Combines g-l3-warm-potato (TEST, plan 0.50) and g-l1-clean-bowl (disclosed).

l3_new.en: Dinner's over. The stove is still on and the pan needs cleaning.
l3_new.fa: شام تمام شد. اجاق هنوز روشن است و تابه هم باید شسته شود.
l3_new.origin: ACC-V2 draft, Astra KEEP twice; Claude reviewer KEEP
l3_new.note: Shallow situational L3 (shutdown + cleaning; extends g-l1-off-stove-knob). The setup turns on ONE knob; the offline check counts knobs one by one (ACC-V2b knob fix). Live: every knob read off from metadata, no order or final pan place required.

l3_new.en: I've finished my snack. Throw out what's left of the apple; the plate is dirty too.

l3_new.origin: ACC-V2 draft, Astra KEEP twice; setup CHANGED per the Claude reviewer
l3_new.note: Discard + implied wash. The setup now puts the apple ON the plate so the scene matches the story (Claude reviewer); the whole apple is the 'remains' proxy (Astra), no slicing needed. Either order passes. Extends g-l3-old-produce and g-l1-clean-plate (disclosed).

l3_new.en: I'm off to work and taking my coffee with me. Hand me my mug of coffee, and don't leave any kitchen appliance on.
l3_new.fa: دارم می‌روم سر کار و قهوه‌ام را با خودم می‌برم. لیوان قهوه‌ام را بده دستم و هیچ‌کدام از دستگاه‌های آشپزخانه را روشن نگذار.
l3_new.origin: ACC-V2b new; EN/FA and goal CHANGED per both reviewers
l3_new.note: Weak L3 (find the brewing mug, find what is on); extends g-l2-find-pickup-mug and g-l3-leaving-house. The opening was changed so it no longer echoes TEST g-l3-leaving-house in Persian (Claude reviewer). 'Kitchen appliance' = the switchable appliances (coffee machine, microwave, toaster, all stove knobs); LightSwitch and Faucet are not appliances and are not scored. The three guards are true at reset and protect the final state (Astra). Holding the mug is the hand-over proxy. Live: the mug keeps its coffee; either order passes.

l3_new.en: The potato is caked in mud. Leave it soaking in a pot of water.

l3_new.origin: ACC-V2 draft, Astra KEEP twice; Claude reviewer: borderline L2, prefers spare
l3_new.note: Modest relational L3 (extends g-l1-fill-pot-water); water + containment is a soaking proxy. Kept in main because Astra (both sessions) keeps it there and both reviewers rank dark-rinse below it; the level disagreement is disclosed. Either preparation order passes.
